name: 44312 · Akron, OH
findings: ZIP 44312 (Akron) has 124 nonprofit organizations. 38 of them (31%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 26 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (37% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 44312 (Akron) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 44312 (Akron) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 66% of the typical level).
